mapper.sql: device_id, server_id, gpu_uuid, name, identity_state, schedulable, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO train_server_gpu_device (server_id, gpu_uuid, name, identity_state, schedulable, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{serverId}, #{gpuUuid}, #{name}, #{identityState}, #{schedulable}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), identity_state = VALUES(identity_state), schedulable = VALUES(schedulable), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM train_server_gpu_device WHERE server_id = #{serverId} AND gpu_uuid = #{gpuUuid}
SELECT FROM train_server_gpu_device WHERE server_id = #{serverId} ORDER BY gpu_uuid
